sources.snippet: DKubeX Documentation # Version v0.2.2 DKubeX is a Kubernetes-native platform for deploying, managing, and operating AI and ML applications from a single control plane. It layers a self-service application catalog, a governed model plane, and integrated developer tooling over a standard Kubernetes cluster — so teams can run the full model lifecycle, from training to governed inference, on ...
